title: Sort dashboard top sources by event count
description: Sort the protected Ops dashboard Top Sources table by event count descending so busiest sources stand out immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard Top Sources uses events-desc ordering; regression coverage proves the busiest seeded source appears first; Ops tests pass.
close_reason: Dashboard Top Sources now sorts by event count descending; regression, Ops suite, and release gates passed.

title: Export filtered Ops events as CSV
description: Add a protected Ops CSV export for the current Events filters so operators can export source-specific event views for offline analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Events page links to a filtered CSV export; export reuses event_type/source_ip/result/limit filters; CSV contains stable event columns; dangerous spreadsheet-leading cells are neutralized; regression tests cover filtering and CSV injection protection.
close_reason: Added protected filtered Ops events CSV export with shared filters, export link, CSV formula neutralization, changelog v1.4.5, and passing Ops/release tests.

title: Highlight Ops control attempts

close_reason: Highlighted HMI control and switching attempts in protected Ops event tables; normal page views remain unmarked; Ops and release tests passed.

title: Widen Ops backend layout with 16:9 cap

acceptance_criteria: Ops shell no longer uses the old 1280px cap; widescreen content is capped by a 16:9 viewport-derived max width; regression coverage asserts the layout rule.
close_reason: Widened protected Ops backend layout to full normal viewport width with a 16:9 cap on widescreen layouts; added regression coverage and backend version entry v1.4.3.

title: Sync Ops backend version log

close_reason: Rewrote README and docs in English, synced Docker production path, HMI/Ops boundary, service logout, and removed stale deployment guidance.

title: Make service inverter controls full width

acceptance_criteria: The first four service control cards remain in the top grid; inverter block control renders in a full-width section below them; mobile layout remains usable; focused HMI tests pass.
close_reason: Moved inverter block control into a full-width service-panel row below the first four controls; HMI integration tests passed.

title: Add HMI service logout action
description: Add a CSRF-protected logout action for the HMI service portal that invalidates the service session server-side and clears the service cookie.
acceptance_criteria: Service panel shows a logout button; POST /service/logout requires a valid service session and CSRF token; logout deletes the server-side session and service cookie; accessing /service/panel after logout returns 401; focused tests pass.
close_reason: Added CSRF-protected service logout that clears server session and cookie; HMI integration tests passed.

title: Replace exposed switch with local debug mode
description: Remove EXPOSED_RESEARCH_ENABLED as a production config switch, make exposure policy the normal runtime gate, introduce explicit HONEYPOT_LOCAL_DEBUG for local/dev bypass, and shorten public documentation accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Production runtime enforces exposure gates by default; local debug bypass requires HONEYPOT_LOCAL_DEBUG=1; .env.example no longer exposes EXPOSED_RESEARCH_ENABLED; docs are shorter and describe Docker production plus optional local debug; tests cover the new semantics.
close_reason: Replaced exposure toggle with local debug mode and shortened public docs

close_reason: Production env example simplified: internal container ports fixed in compose, only host-published ports remain configurable, reserved V1 values moved to commented reference block, docs and tests updated.

title: Set VPS direct-port compose defaults

close_reason: Direct VPS Compose defaults set HMI to host port 80, keep Ops on loopback, docs synced and tests passed.
